message.content:
I don’t have access to live weather feeds right now, so I can’t give you an up‑to‑date forecast. However, here’s what you typically see:

| Season | Typical Weather |
|--------|------------------|
| **Winter** (Dec–Feb) | Cool & damp – temperatures usually range from ~48 °F (9 °C) at night to ~58 °F (14 °C) during the day. Foggy mornings are common. |
| **Spring** (Mar–May) | Mild and gradually warming – daytime highs around 60–68 °F (15–20 °C). Rainfall starts tapering off toward late spring. |
| **Summer** (Jun–Aug) | Warm but rarely hot – daytime averages stay between 65–75 °F (18–24 °C), with cooler evenings due to marine breezes. Rare heat waves push temps into the low 80s (27–28 °C). |
| **Fall** (Sep–Nov) | Similar to summer early on, then cooling down to mid‑50s °F (12–13 °C) by November. Occasional fog rolls in again as winter approaches. |

If you need today’s exact temperature, humidity, wind speed, precipitation chance, etc., it’s best to check a trusted source such as:
* National Weather Service (weather.gov)
* AccuWeather.com
* Weather Underground (wunderground.com)
* Your phone’s built‑in weather app

Those sites will also let you know if there’s a storm warning, air quality alert, or anything else worth noting.

Let me know if you'd like help interpreting a specific forecast line!
